correctness.rationale: Exact 10-term coefficient convolution/Parseval gives the five-cosine identity. The phase change x=(psi-phi)/2,y=(psi-3phi)/2 is exact on phase representatives and reduces the global two-torus infimum without relaxation to a one-variable F(t)=112+288t²-132t-48t³. F″(t)>0 for all t in [0,1], its unique root t*=(12-sqrt111)/6 lies inside, and radical substitution gives the constant. Equality in the cosine minimization forces psi=3phi mod 2pi and cos(phi)=-t*, thus two conjugate orbits. Standalone exact checker verifies the Laurent identity and radical arithmetic; numerical quadrature is independent corroboration, not universal proof.
